rv.q: There are contested memories with gentle shocks and apologies. It is beautifully done through their exchanges on the beach. Writer Tim Foley has won several awards for past works (including the Bruntwood prize) and it is clear, from the love and lyricism in this script, that he is a striking talent.
First seen in 2023, Tim Foley’s tender play about two brothers grieving for their father, directed by Neil Bettles and Elle While, returns on tour
